name: Karnu Glass Horizon
passives: Solar Law — Karnu's Mastery: Karnu's Solar Power: a solo curse ledger that grows when the Titan uses illuminated terrain to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Karnu Glass Horizon is the long sight of the solar barque: he reads enemies where sky, river, and desert meet. Human obelisks and horizon sanctuaries are static imitations of his living range geometry.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Artillery Titan with sweeping solar-barge shoulder arcs, desert-glass lens organs, falcon-eye targeting visor, bronze horizon vanes, lapis braces, and mirage-light cannon geometry grown from the body. Avoid sci-fi sniper/mech; every range element should feel like sacred astronomy made alive.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Karnu Longshot Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Radiant damage at range 5; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from illuminated terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Pylon Zone Bombardment
abilityDetails.effect: Apply ranged area damage and objective-zone denial; also builds 10 Solar Charge when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Karnu Glass Horizon: Horizon Cataclysm
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Solar Charge to create a two-round battlefield rule around illuminated terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Pylon Radiant Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Solar Charge, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Aten Pylon Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +5 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Karnu Glass Horizon Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +1 armor and +1 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Karnu Solar Charge Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Solar Charge cap +20. At 80+ Solar Charge, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Solar Charge.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: project damage into crowds and objective zones

mythicSource: Solar barque horizon + desert glass + long-range Ra sight
armorCanon: barque-arc shoulder rig, desert-glass lens array, falcon-eye sight lines, polished bronze range vanes, lapis shadow braces
